risks: The backoff sleep is a plain tokio::time::sleep: a shutdown during a backoff is only noticed when the sleep ends, so a stop can wait up to 240 s on the 5th backoff before the Launch returns (no further tab is opened, as claimed). Spec decision 4 permits this, but SIGTERM latency may be long.
Every terminal-backed Launch now spends the full 1 s exit probe before spawned (seen: ~1.5 s from second tab.create to spawned); full 50-min suite not run to confirm no other case's timing moved.
